title: A query with several EVALUATE statements returns one result for each, in order

source.quote: A DAX query can contain multiple EVALUATE statements.
There might be multiple query expressions, each introduced by EVALUATE and each with its own set of result modifiers.
source.supports: each EVALUATE is its own query expression

derivation: Two EVALUATE statements, two results: the first has the column [a] with 1, the second the columns [b] and [c] with "x" and TRUE.
